post_meta.author: sierra_wanderer
post_meta.title: Kearsarge Pass conditions 6/10
post_meta.text: Went over Kearsarge on Saturday. Snow free on the east side until about 11,200, then continuous snow to the top. North side still holds a big snowfield maybe 200 feet long. We had microspikes and were glad to have them at 7am, by 10 it was mashed potatoes. Bubbs Creek crossing was knee high and dropping.

extraction.quote_span: I was on spikes and wishing for an axe

post_meta.author: u/switchbacksally
post_meta.title: Kearsarge in and nope
post_meta.text: Went in over Kearsarge 6/3 to resupply cache. Continuous snow from the lakes on, north side is a real snowfield with a runout onto rocks, I was on spikes and wishing for an axe. Watched two guys glissade it and it made my stomach turn. I am waiting two weeks before I try Glen.

post_meta.author: sierra_wanderer
post_meta.title: Kearsarge again 7/1
post_meta.text: Back over Kearsarge on the 1st. Big change in three weeks, snow free to maybe 11,500 now, north side field is half the size and there is a clean boot path through it. Nobody in our group used traction. Bubbs down to mid calf. Summer is coming fast.
